protocol: Three nested teachers, eight unseen booking folds. The base calibrates the three logits on outer-training orders. Manifest features, interactions with mean teacher probability, and L2 coefficient are identical across the pooled and regional fits. Each departure-specific model learns a log-odds correction; maximin combines them with the smallest training-population L2 norm. Shuffled assigns departure at booking level within booking size. The environmental models exclude unknown-departure training bookings; every passenger is scored. No names.
